brand_identity.name: MicroSkill
brand_identity.ethos: Learn genius skills in 5 minutes. Optimistic, futuristic, clear.

layout.grid_system: Use 'Bento' style grids. Mix wide and tall cards.

cards.classes: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-lg border border-white/50 shadow-lg rounded-3xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold text-white bg-gradient-to-b from-sky-400 to-sky-600 shadow-lg shadow-sky-200 hover:shadow-sky-300 transition-all active:scale-95 border-t border-white/30
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold text-slate-700 bg-white/80 hover:bg-white border border-white/60 shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md transition-all
buttons.ghost: rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium text-slate-600 hover:bg-sky-50 hover:text-sky-600 transition-colors

inputs.classes: bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-sm border border-slate-200 focus:border-sky-400 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-100 transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400

navigation.classes: fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 shadow-2xl rounded-full px-6 py-3 z-50 flex items-center gap-6

decorations: Floating bubbles (absolute positioned div with rounded-full, gradient bg, blur)

animations.float: animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 3, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
animations.fade_in: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: 'Outfit' and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' from Google Fonts immediately.
Install 'framer-motion' for the floating bubble effects.
Use the Glassmorphism card style for ALL content containers (lessons, categories).
Set the global background to a subtle gradient (Sky Blue to White).
Do NOT use flat colors. Always use gradients or glass overlays.
For the Hero section, use the provided cloud/sky background with a heavy blur or overlay.
Categories should be colorful glossy cards (Green for Finance, Blue for Tech, Pink for Psych).
The progress bar should be a glossy 'liquid' bar (rounded-full, gradient fill, inner shadow).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'SaaS Blue' flat design. This must look like 2025 Frutiger Aero.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
